name: IconFix
description: Adds an "Icon With Name" checkbox (off by default) to the icon picker: when on, picking an icon also inserts its name text, e.g. \meik-; (icon + name) instead of \meik; (icon only). Shift+Click inverts the checkbox; Shift+Click a plain icon inside a text field upgrades it in place (configurable). 图标选取新增「图标附带名称」勾选框（默认关闭）：开启时选取图标附带名称文本；Shift+点击临时取反；Shift+点击文本框中的纯图标可原地补上名称（均可配置）。
